text:
elena (product): quick sync — we need a conservative plan for EU+APAC cutover for the new routing/quantized-model fallback. primary asks: safe default, per-tenant opt-out, and an automatic hedge that swaps traffic to backup model within X errors.
kevin (eng-platform): +1. propose staged switch: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h with telemetry gates. auto-rollback if p95 latency or error rate spikes.
ash (ash) (sre): call it out: latency p95 threshold = 600ms, error-rate threshold = +1.5% absolute. also need a circuit-breaker that kicks in under regional capacity pressure.
maria (eng-runtime): runtime notes: the backup is quantized-gpt-small; compatible but lower RTF. we can enable prefix KV cache warmup for canaries. need to pin model version in flag.
elena (product): sounds good. two product decisions: (A) tenant opt-out button (manual bypass) vs auto-exempt for enterprise customers, (B) whether to run an A/B quality check (shadow compare) during the 20% step.
ben (solutions): customers will ask for auto-exempt; suggest enterprise tenants default opt-out but AB test allowed. also add a short opt-out webhook for partner ops.
kevin (eng-platform): here's the flag schema I suggest:```json
{
  "flag": "routing.autoswap_v1",
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 1, "gate": "smoke"},
    {"pct": 5, "gate": "telemetry_24h"},
    {"pct": 20, "gate": "shadow_quality"},
    {"pct": 50, "gate": "telemetry_48h"},
    {"pct": 100, "gate": "manual_signoff"}
  ],
  "failover": {"type": "regional", "targets": ["backup-quantized"], "ttl": 300},
  "opt_out_groups": ["enterprise", "partner_ops"]
}
```
ash (ash) (sre): add circuit-breaker config snippet:```yaml
circuit_breaker:
  p95_latency_ms: 600
  error_rate_absolute: 1.5
  sustained_window_s: 300
  action: route_to_backup
```
maria (eng-runtime): runtime additions: need to pre-warm KV cache for any tenant in stage >=20%. I'll add an API to request warmup during rollout window. also recommend we enable request-level tracing to link requests to flag cohort.
elena (product): telemetry gating details: for the "shadow_quality" gate we want: BLEU/ROUGE for structured tasks, and a qualitative sample of 200 prompts flagged as "safety/meaning-drift". we will surface regression alert if delta > 2% on key metrics.
enela (typo-correction): ignore, typo.
ben (solutions): ops note: make opt-out webhook idempotent and log audit events to customer logs. customers expect 48h SLA on opt-out activation.
kevin (eng-platform): ops checklist before 1%: feature-flag rollout path created, dashboard with p95/p50/error-rate and qualitative sample link, automated rollback job, pre-warm hook, and runbook doc.
nash (ash) (sre): runbook bullets: who calls manual fallback (oncall + product lead), how to escalate to infra, how to toggle flag globally, and how to drain canaries from LB. add a quick-fire checklist for PD and CS.
elena (product): launch criteria (must pass):
- shadow_quality gate at 20% passes for 48h (delta < 2%)
- no p95 or error spike beyond thresholds for 48h in each region
- enterprise opt-out path tested and documented
- runbook + dashboard verified with SRE and CS
if any fail, auto-decrement to last safe stage and open pager.
kevin (eng-platform): I'll open a PR for the flag config + rollout automation this afternoon. deploy-bot will create canary deployments.
deploy-bot: deploy starting: routing.autoswap_v1 canary 1% -> infra group 'eu-west-1' + 'ap-southeast-1' scheduled. :rocket:
elena (product): thanks — let's meet 11:00 PT tomorrow for signoff if PR + dashboard are green. cc @ash @kevin @maria :thumbsup:
kevin (eng-platform): :thumbsup: I'll add the shadow compare job to the telemetry pipeline.
maria (eng-runtime): will add tracing tag: flag.cohort and warmup hook.
nash (ash) (sre): I'll author the runbook and smoke test scripts.
ben (solutions): I'll prep the partner opt-out webhook spec and CS blurb.
elena (product): pairing notes: we should keep the 48h windows flexible if early indicators are very positive or negative — but default will be 48h.
kevin (eng-platform): one more: add a grace-period circuit that only auto-routes if region CPU load > 85% for >2m, to avoid flapping.
nash (ash) (sre): agree. that's in the CB config.
elena (product): good progress — final ask: encode telemetry gate names into the flag so ops can see stage status in Console. otherwise we'll lose context.
kevin (eng-platform): noted. PR will include metadata for Console.
ben (solutions): can we add a small customer-facing note template for when we flip to backup for their tenant? saves CS cycles.
elena (product): yes — Ben please draft and share in #customer-success after PR lands.
kevin (eng-platform): timeline: PR today, review EOD, deploy 1% tomorrow AM, sync 11:00 PT.
elena (product): perfect. thanks all.
